name: safeledger-guardrail
description: SafeLedger banking assistant: prompt attacks, off-topic requests, card and account numbers
blockedInputMessaging: Sorry, I can't process that message. Please ask again in your own words. I can help with your own accounts, cards, transactions, payees and disputes.
blockedOutputsMessaging: Sorry, I can't process that message. Please ask again in your own words. I can help with your own accounts, cards, transactions, payees and disputes.

topicsConfig.name: Investment advice
topicsConfig.definition: Recommendations or opinions on which stocks, funds, crypto or other investments to buy, sell or hold, or predictions of their returns.
examples: Which mutual fund should I put my savings into?
Should I buy Bitcoin with my salary?
Is it a good time to invest in the stock market?

topicsConfig.name: Unrelated to banking
topicsConfig.definition: Requests that have nothing to do with the customer's own bank accounts, cards, transactions, payees or disputes, such as coding, essays, trivia or general chat.
examples: Write me a poem about the sea.
Help me debug my Python code.
Who won the cricket world cup?

regexesConfig.name: Card number
regexesConfig.description: 13 to 19 digits, optionally grouped with spaces or dashes
